Type: ottoman
Name: First Hill Elaina Square Fabric Storage Ottoman with Script-Style Pattern - Neutral Beige
Colors: Brown
Materials: Fabric
Small square-shaped storage ottoman for use as a footrest and/or storage; ideal for a living room, study, or bedroom Padded lid hinges open for access to interior storage space—holds anything from books and games to extra throws Elegant script-style fabric upholstery in neutral brown and beige hues; antique-look nail-head trim along the base 4 block-style feet in an accenting dark color provide reliable strength and stability Measures 17.5 by 17.5 by 17.8 inches; minimal assembly required
